verdict.rationale: Anytype's OpenAPI spec shows the local API uses keys that can be revoked or expire ("Missing, unknown, revoked or expired key"), so per-agent credentials can be issued for MCP or agent-skill access. Nothing in the evidence shows those keys can be scoped to particular spaces, objects, or read-only access, which is the core least-privilege part of the story. Missing for 10: documented per-key scopes or permissions (space/object restriction, read-only vs write), a key issuance and management workflow, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
